# pai pause

Save your place before leaving a session

```
pai pause [TARGET] [options]
```

Writes a "Continue" block into the project's TODO.md so the next session knows where you stopped, then tells you how to leave safely.
`pai pause all` does it for every live session through AIBroker. Leave with /exit inside Claude Code; Ctrl+C skips the stop hook.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TARGET` | no | Only the word `all`: pause every live session |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--body-file FILE` | string | — | File holding the checkpoint text to save ('-' reads standard input). Required unless --no-body |
| `--session-id UUID` | string | — | Claude Code session id; recorded as the handle for `claude --resume` |
| `--no-body` | flag | — | Save a checkpoint with metadata only, no text |
| `--exit` | flag | — | With `all`: also send /exit to each session after it has saved |
| `--only NAME` | string | — | With `all`: only sessions whose name or id contains NAME (to rehearse on one tab first) |
| `--wait MS` | number | 180000 | With `all`: longest wait for a session to finish its checkpoint before /exit; busy ones are left open, never killed |
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | Show what would be written, write nothing |

```sh
pai pause --dry-run --no-body
pai pause --body-file checkpoint.md
pai pause all --dry-run
pai pause all --only api --exit
```

See also: `pai end`, `pai session handover`
